verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs state it supports the Anthropic Messages API and that this API is compatible with Claude clients. That directly covers calling the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint. The documentation is thin, though: only one-line mentions, with no endpoint path, request examples or feature-parity details. Missing for 10: documented endpoint path and request/response examples, details on streaming and tool-use parity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: LocalAI supports the Anthropic Messages API, which is compatible with Claude clients.
LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.
